title: Portrait / character art
description: Character portraits and key art (dialogue portraits, cards, menus) at full resolution. Z-Image Turbo.
prompt_template: {prompt}{style}. Character portrait for a game, head and shoulders, expressive face, detailed, centred
prompt_guide: Who, their expression, outfit and the mood/lighting: 'a grizzled dwarf blacksmith with a braided grey beard, soot on his cheeks, warm forge light, determined look'. Set remove_background true for a cut-out dialogue portrait.

param_help.model: diffusion model file (the preset normally picks it)
param_help.steps: sampling steps (the distilled models are made for 4 / 8)
param_help.candidates: takes generated in one batch; the best match to the prompt that passes the checks is kept
param_help.remove_background: cut the subject out with BiRefNet (transparent PNG)
param_help.defringe: re-colour soft edges so no grey halo shows on dark backgrounds
param_help.size: output canvas in pixels (square); null keeps the tight crop at full resolution
param_help.padding: empty margin around the sprite, as a share of the canvas
param_help.anchor: center, or bottom (feet on the ground line - characters and animation frames)
param_help.background: what the model is told to put behind the subject; plain and light makes the cut-out cleanest
param_help.rank_by_clip: rank the takes by how well they match the prompt (CLIP)
param_help.keep_candidates: keep every take in .spriteforge/<name>/ next to the result
